# Prepared Tyrell XY validation and evaluation-order repair

This independent C API models a bounded empty-queue scalar XY consumer using caller-owned state. The actual comparator invokes the installed original getter-returned consumer with fresh owned configuration/descriptor/cell clones and an unchanged original receiver whose pinned entry/exit callback is a six-byte no-op. It does not produce naturally active XY configuration, reconstruct the original class or process audio.

The former candidate `57600b08acd68c9c808ecf8b585724402141c78ec87debc515026965946963d6` passed its 760 fixed native cases and root's separate six additions. The expanded reviewer corpus nevertheless found a valid-input status difference: source FE mask 0x22 versus native 0x20 when an unused subnormal raw/cell/depth/endpoint was evaluated by floating validation. Frozen finding `20657bbbb260dfa4a188eeb5d369d4dcb357f9307e89a2d329e7e50885929185` preserves that failure. Those historical fixed-case passes remain true; they do not accept the wider declared domain.

Finite magnitudes now use IEEE float bit magnitudes against the positive finite domain limit. Endpoint ordering uses monotonic integer keys after finite validation and treats both signed zeros as equal. Validation no longer evaluates unused floating values. It never clears, restores or raises caller exception flags. The product, contribution, logical marks, ordered clamp, alias and scratch behavior remains unchanged.

An initial integer-only repair exposed a separate ordering gap at O0: with an active subnormal coordinate and only skipped target records, source raised no flag while native raised Darwin FE_DENORMALOPERAND (0x2). At O2 the compiler had hoisted the comparison and concealed the gap. Frozen report `9235b9ee32feed408c459e1479f233a29bc4deb4a419d600b4863b4c777a1106` preserves the initial source, signed module and both signs. Root amendment `4f99458167db7e7ba194755e534d2f0003bd97ac9caaef6256cf4fedf294bd36` authorized the exact fix: evaluate coordinate>0 before the target loop and reuse that boolean. `#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS ON`, together with the strict compiler flags, makes that evaluation observable rather than dependent on optimizer motion. No artificial exception-flag operations occur in the API.

Geometry is unchanged: N2..213, X1..4, T1..16, duplicate-inclusive X*T<=64, queue0/-1, S/P/U zero and exactly X full int32 type2 descriptor IDs strictly1..N-1. Every slot addresses an owned cell; aliases retain logical-ID accumulation and first-occurrence clamp order. Native configuration allocation is align16(400+28*N+16*X*T+4*X), descriptor stride116; 64 scratch entries end at byte395 and bytes396..399 are preserved. Packed fields use memcpy. Missing/extra type2, malformed pointers/geometry and positive queues never reach the original consumer.

Run `python3 verify_public.py` from this directory. It first verifies the published source closure, then creates an isolated ignored copy at the same project-relative depth and runs the unchanged `verify_all.sh` there. Set `VL_TYRELL_XY_PUBLIC_WORK` to a new output directory if needed. The lower-level recipe accepts `VL_TYRELL_XY_REPAIR_WORK_DIR`; use it only in a separate copied source tree because it generates reports beside its copied sources. Both source module and harness are instrumented in fatal runs; the installed original remains plain. Own Intel artifacts are ad-hoc signed and strictly verified before execution. Fatal ASan/UBSan/float-cast-overflow builds disable sanitizer recovery and logs reject diagnostics. Ordinary original factory/close/log/preference side effects remain outside selected-byte preservation; incidental CPU-watch log text need not match.

The replay covers the old760 native cases and six scalar negatives;144 cleared and144 inherited-FE endpoint/order pairs per mode; nine isolated unused-field/active-coordinate native pairs; the same nine at O0;1488 validation-only source calls on arm64/x86 in normal/fatal modes; and four validation/order mutants. The source-only test intentionally separates 12 active-subnormal coordinate/seed combinations from its unchanged-fenv assertion because coordinate comparison is actual XY work. Positive/negative all-skipped subnormal coordinates are compared against the original instead. Full caller fenv snapshots are restored/read back by the fixtures; the API retains the measured native arithmetic side effects.

Two failed supplemental fixtures are retained honestly: an own pure-helper timing assertion was corrected using an observable volatile sink; an initial full-fenv source test incorrectly assumed all skipped targets meant no coordinate comparison. The latter's exact API-only captures and source/native disassembly established the active comparison, and the separate O0 test revealed the real order gap. A failed or unexecuted earlier source is never described as a passing run.

Two independent copied reviews accepted this bounded repair. One added 90,123 source checks per module and 2,304 fresh native pairs per mode; the other added six shared-cell/scalar-reuse cases with the actual inherited environment applied separately to source and native calls. The public acceptance manifest binds both reviews. Generated builder reports remain labeled as builder results. General floating environments, unmasked traps, arbitrary compiler code generation, same native-allocation history, positive queue, original constructor/class/unit ownership, natural XY, audio, host scheduler, editor, real-time and complete plugin equivalence are unproved. Every original replay uses a valid fresh caller-owned clone; no original VFT, callback, configuration, descriptor or pointee is patched. Source calls and all accesses to shared caller storage must be serialized.
